description: Renter only. Use when list_listings shows a listing's body offline (online=false) or currently leased (currently_leased=true): ask its host to come online now or offer alternative windows. Reserves nothing by itself. Answer arrives via your notify_method or list_inquiries.

body_kind.description: Which of the listing's bodies you are asking about; required when it offers both.

message.description: Optional note to the host (max 500 chars).

window_start.description: ISO 8601 datetime: the window you wanted.

name: create_inquiry
title: Ask a host about availability
